messages:
Maria Chen: quick sync 1: mock for a condensed multi-invite flow in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ. goal: keyboard-first, fewer clicks when assigning the same role to many people. Jon Patel: digging the compact layout. concern: how do we indicate SSO enforcement per batch? a small badge on the preset might be easy to miss. :thinking_face: Elaine Rodriguez: agree on badge + accessibility: when role preset is focused, put a clear aria-label like 'Role: Billing Admin, SSO required'. also make sure the preset list is reachable by keyboard only. Sam Kaur: copy suggestion: replace "Invite as: Role" with "Assign role" across the flow. shorter and screen-reader friendly. also change the success toast to verb-first: "Invites sent 3 recipients" Alex Li: implementation note: current mock opens a modal to edit role permissions. that breaks keyboard flow. propose inline expanding row for permission tweaks to keep focus linear. Rachel Gomez: also need analytics: add events invite.express.started, invite.express.completed, role_preset.selected. will send event schema. cc @design-bot design-bot: event schema link: https://redwood.co/events/INV-212; recommended props: preset_id, sso_required, recipient_count Maria Chen: accessibility prototype idea: use role selection as a radiogroup for single-role batches and a checkbox group for multi-role assigns. announce changes via aria-live. example snippet below: ```html
Developer
Admin
Role: Developer. SSO: Enabled. ``` Jon Patel: looks good. small visual note: focus ring contrast was low on the dark theme; use a thicker ring or contrasting color. link: https://contrastchecker.example.com/456 Elaine Rodriguez: copy tweak for failures: instead of "Invite failed" use "Invite blocked by SSO policy" so users know it's a policy hit, not a delivery error. include which user and which policy when possible. Sam Kaur: from usability testing: users missed 'manage presets' buried under a menu. move 'Manage role presets' into the left rail under Quick actions to improve discoverability. Alex Li: edge case: when a batch contains mixed domains and only some are SSO-enforced, show inline per-recipient status with a one-click action to "Resend with SSO" for blocked recipients. keeps remediation fast. Rachel Gomez: product supports that. we should add UI flag to disable resend-for-you when policy is strict. i'll add a note to the constraints doc. Maria Chen: i'll update the Figma with inline expand, SSO badge, and a left-rail shortcut. Elaine and Sam can review a11y and copy. PR reference when ready. Elaine Rodriguez: i'll run a keyboard + NVDA pass Thursday and post findings. Sam Kaur: i'll open a small PR for copy + aria attributes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/4221 Alex Li: css reminder: don't remove outlines; for custom focus, pair with a visible fallback. Maria Chen: thanks all. reconvene after PRs and the a11y pass. :thumbsup:
